[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
143 Unova pokemon for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47809]Pokemon Battle Companions[/url]

Unova is the first of the content packs where I'm running into missing assets from [url=https://sprites.pmdcollab.org/#/]PMDCollab[/url]. If you're a sprite artist and want to contribute, I encourage you to do so!

The Following pokemon are missing. They are either skipped during evolution chains, or their evolved forms are directly in the catch pools. (As applicable).  For now this means that they are uncatchable and not included in the content pack.

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
Extract in the Stardew Valley Mod's Folder

[b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]
This is a content pack for PBC, and it needs that mod to function. Installing this on its own will do nothing.

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47809]Pokemon Battle Companions[/url]
